title: stipa pennata subsp. anomala
intro: Stipa pennata subsp. anomala, commonly known as Tibetan needle grass, is a subspecies of the Stipa pennata plant. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Tibetan and Chinese medicine, due to its health benefits which include lowering cholesterol levels, improving digestion, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Stipa pennata subsp. anomala include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
